doc: Iron isolation (owner 2026-11-04): why does the agent not get past iron? The kit holds 1 stack of cobblestone, 2 stone pickaxes, 1 stack of sticks, 5 crafting tables and 8 coal (the fuel; `smelt` loads it into the furnace itself, so a furnace 'loaded with fuel' is a furnace plus coal in the inventory). Iron is a connected cluster of 3 to 5 ore blocks on the surface, so the 3 ingots of an iron pickaxe are always there. No hostile mob spawns and a death gives the kit back. Only the iron-tier entries pay (collect_iron, smelt_iron, craft_iron_pickaxe, craft_iron_sword); every other entry is shown as already reached, nothing else is paid (survival, death, invalid-command terms weigh 0). C: the iron is directly in front (2-3 blocks) and the only furnace is 49-51 blocks away in a random direction (the kit's 64 cobblestone also allows crafting a new one: the run records which way the policy goes).
